mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% y-o-y for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline for three consecutive months, it signals an overheating labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 55 for two consecutive months, it signals a strengthening industrial sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by > 3% y-o-y for three consecutive months, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 3% y-o-y for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
